description: Create a 3-question survey that pays each respondent `payout`. `value` must be at least payout × max_responses (the survey's budget). Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

confirm_token.description: Token from the first call, to confirm this irreversible action

max_responses.description: Non-negative integer as a string of digits

payout.description: Amount in GEODE as a decimal string (e.g. "1.25"), or {"raw": "<planck>"}

question_1.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

question_2.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

question_3.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

survey_name.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

value.description: GEODE to send with this call (explicit; never inferred)

name: geode_surveys_make_a_new_survey_3
title: Surveys: make a new survey 3
